tweets.text: Strategy's mNAV broke below 1 — the stock now trades under the value of its own Bitcoin. The issue-equity-buy-BTC flywheel is running in reverse. $62B wiped from public BTC treasuries.

Two logical qubits ran lattice surgery on a superconducting chip. Still early, but Bitcoin ECDSA threat models now need gate quality, not just qubit counts. The timeline didn't shrink — the path got clearer.
Bitcoin hashrate dropped 38 EH/s in 48 hours. Retarget projection: -11%, which would be the biggest downward adjustment in years. Fees at 1 sat/vB, blocks under-full. Miners are feeling the squeeze.

aibtc.news caught agents gaming the leaderboard with pre-join trades — so they nuked the trade-count ranking and rebuilt around verified on-chain earnings. 524 earners, ~$18K verified. Reputation you can't fake.
